newsitem.title: UK: UK business failure rates drops in Q1 - survey.
newsitem.headline: UK business failure rates drops in Q1 - survey.

text.p: The number of British businesses going bust dropped in the first quarter of this year, according to a survey published on Tuesday.
The number of business failures fell to 10,329 in the quarter compared with 11,430 in the same period of 1996, according to the survey by Dun and Bradstreet, the business information company.
Dun and Bradstreet said a decline of 13.7 percent in the proportion of larger companies going into liquidation was mainly behind the overall drop.
Company liquidations fell to 4,517 in the first quarter of this year from 5,237 in the first three months of 1996.
Business failures dropped in every region of the the UK except the West Midlands.
